{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for completed orders
df_completed = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Convert 'revenue' from string to float, removing commas
df_completed['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(df_completed['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check for sentinel values (999999.99)
print("Count of sentinel values (999999.99):", (df_completed['revenue'] == 999999.99).sum())

# Identify sentinel rows
sentinel_rows = df_completed[df_completed['revenue'] == 999999.99]
print("Sentinel rows (order_id, channel, customer_segment):")
print(sentinel_rows[['order_id', 'channel', 'customer_segment']].to_string(index=False))"}
